page.overview:
Who is Charlotte Allmeg?

Charlotte Allmeg is the 32nd daughter and 72nd child of the Charlotte Family and the eighth of the Charlotte Decuplets to be born. She is also an officer of the Big Mom Pirates.

Allmeg is an average-sized young woman with long brown hair styled in an afro with a pink bow on top. She wears a pink sleeveless dress with a light blue ribbon and red heart badge, white gloves, horizontally-striped pink and white leggings, and red-pink high heels.

Allmeg is excited by large gatherings of people as they feel like festivals to her. She greatly looks up to her older brother Katakuri and becomes furious at the implication of him losing. She considers her older sister Brûlée a "klutz".

As an officer of the Big Mom Pirates, Allmeg has authority over lower-ranking members of their crew.
